Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Arabic

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Arabic
public class Arabic extends Object
Arabic-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_ARABIC section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x05.
